footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Newsmax: after $4.7M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 10.7% to $189M in 2025. Gross margin was 39.3%, versus 45.6% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $99.9M from $69.8M.
The net loss widened to $104M, or −$0.96 per share, from $80.2M. Operating cash flow was −$104M and free cash flow −$107M, versus −$49.7M; Newsmax returned $915K through dividends.
sources: Newsmax Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

revenueLine.say: Broadcasting made up 81 percent of revenue.
